risks.risk: The camera may not power on or the shutter may be near the end of its life.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on and taking a photo.

risks.risk: The lens glass may have fungus, scratches, or haze.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the lens glass with the cap removed.

risks.risk: The image sensor may be scratched or have dead pixels.
risks.proof: A photo of the sensor with the lens removed.

risks.risk: The battery may be dead or the charger may not hold a charge.
risks.proof: A video showing the battery charging and the camera running on battery power.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Photo of the lens glass with the cap removed.
Photo of the camera sensor with the lens removed.
Photo of the battery and charger.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
